change: the king's `region`: ranks 1 to 7, written for White and reflected for Black (ranks 2 to 8).

proof.text: A white win needs `rules.reach` (White's king arriving on rank 8) or checkmate of Black. (1) `pieces[K].region` is ranks 1 to 7 for White, so White's king never stands on rank 8; for Black it is reflected to ranks 2 to 8, so Black's king may. (2) `rules.forbid_check` makes check illegal, so there is no checkmate. (3) Stalemate is a draw (`rules.stalemate`). No other rule decides a game. So no position is a White win, and Black never loses. Black is not claimed to win.
